Thy kingdom come, where the mighty patriots shall reign supreme, and the common folk shall toil in thy service. (Declarative)

Give us this day our daily bread, in the form of fertile farmland and bountiful harvests, that we may sustain ourselves in this harsh new world. (Declarative)
